description: This file defines report functions for generating a delivery note trends report within the ERPNext application. It includes functions to execute report data retrieval and chart data preparation, utilizing external modules for data fetching and column definitions.

methods.name: execute(filters=None)
methods.description: Main entry point for generating the delivery note trends report, which consolidates data, applies filters, and prepares chart data.

methods.name: get_chart_data(data, filters)
methods.description: Prepares data suitable for chart visualization, filtering top entries and formatting labels and datasets.
